narrative.overview: The hub is a tool people check, not a page they browse. Surfaces are grayscale: white or near-black background, hairline borders, light muted fills for chrome. The only color at rest is the primary blue on the one main action per screen and the project's own identity color in the title bar. Everything else that is colored is status: green means running or passed, red means failed, amber means a warning or something unsaved. When a screen is all gray, nothing needs the operator.
keyCharacteristics: Grayscale chrome, color reserved for status and identity.
One primary (filled) button per screen; everything else is outlined or text.
Hairline 1px borders and tonal fills instead of shadows.
Small type (14px body, 12px metadata), monospace for ids, commands, code and diffs.
Light and dark are equal; every color comes from a token that has both.

rules.name: The Gray-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A screen with nothing wrong and nothing running is grayscale plus one blue button. Status color appears only when its state is true.

rules.name: The Text-Shade Rule
rules.body: Colored text uses the *-text token, which chunks-ui clamps to 4.5:1 in both themes. Never text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 or text-rose-500.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or be compared uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Machine-Text Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks text a machine produced or consumes. It is not a technical costume for headings, buttons or chat placeholders.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px border-border line or a tonal step, not a shadow. A shadow means the thing floats above the page.

dos: Do import every visual primitive from `@/ui`; add a re-export there when a screen first needs
Do use semantic tokens (`bg-success`, `text-destructive-text`, `border-border`) so both themes
Do keep one primary button per screen and put it at the right end of the page header row.
Do use the glossary words (Task, Run, Proof of Work, Stage, PR/MR) exactly.
Do give icon-only buttons an `aria-label` and every overlay dialog semantics.
Do use `tabular-nums` on numbers and monospace on ids, commands and code.
Do run the design detector over changed UI before committing (below).
donts: Don't use raw Tailwind palette colors (`text-green-600`, `bg-rose-500/5`) for status; only
Don't put a thick colored left border on cards, callouts or alerts (`border-l-4`).
Don't color a whole panel for a passed state; status color goes on the dot, chip or text.
Don't add display-size type, gradients, glass or decorative illustration.
Don't add uppercase eyebrow labels above page headings.
Don't leak internal ticket refs (`(S6)`, `#491`) or the old `vanguard` name into UI copy.
